# Helvety Tasks

> Stage-based Helvety Tasks board: ciphertext for titles, descriptions, and schedule fields, with optional in-tab list search once you unlock. MIT-licensed open source, Swiss-built.

## Canonical URL
- [Tasks App](https://helvety.com/tasks): Auth-required task management route

## Crawling And Indexing
- Tasks routes are intended not to be indexed.
- These routes are not intended as crawl targets and are protected by noindex metadata and authentication controls.
